options.name: authtype
options.description: Authentication method used for SSH script type. Used if type is C(ssh).

options.name: command
options.description: Command to run. Required when state is 'present'

options.name: confirmation
options.description: Confirmation pop up text. The pop up will appear when trying to run the script from the Zabbix frontend. Used if scope is C(manual_host_action) or C(manual_event_action).

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the script.

options.name: execute_on
options.description: Where to run the script. Used if type is C(script).

options.name: host_access
options.description: Host permissions needed to run the script. Used if scope is C(manual_host_action) or C(manual_event_action).

options.name: host_group
options.description: host group name that the script can be run on. If set to "all", the script will be available on all host groups.

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: menu_path
options.description: Folders separated by slash that form a menu like navigation in frontend when clicked on host or event. Used if scope is C(manual_host_action) or C(manual_event_action).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the script.

options.name: new_window
options.description: Should URL be opened in a new window? Only available if script_type is C(url)

options.name: parameters
options.description: Array of webhook input parameters. Used if type is C(webhook).

options.name: password
options.description: Password used for SSH scripts with password authentication and Telnet scripts. Used if type is C(ssh) and authtype is C(password) or type is C(telnet).

options.name: port
options.description: Port number used for SSH and Telnet scripts. Used if type is C(ssh) or C(telnet).

options.name: privatekey
options.description: Name of the private key file used for SSH scripts with public key authentication. Used if type is C(ssh) and authtype is C(public_key).

options.name: publickey
options.description: Name of the public key file used for SSH scripts with public key authentication. Used if type is C(ssh) and authtype is C(public_key).

options.name: scope
options.description: Script scope.

options.name: script_timeout
options.description: Webhook script execution timeout in seconds. Time suffixes are supported, e.g. 30s, 1m. Required if type is C(webhook). Possible values: 1-60s.

options.name: script_type
options.description: Script type. Required when state is 'present'. A value of 'url' is only available in 7.0 or later

options.name: state
options.description: State of the script.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL for quick access Required if script_type is C(url) Only available if script_type is C(url)

options.name: user_group
options.description: user group name that will be allowed to run the script. If set to "all", the script will be available for all user groups. Used if scope is C(manual_host_action) or C(manual_event_action).

options.name: user_input_default_input
options.description: Default user input Available if user_input_type is C(regex) Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: user_input_enabled
options.description: Allow advanced user input configuration Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: user_input_list
options.description: A list of possible choices for the user. Required if user_input_type is C(dropdown). NOTE the first option will be the default. Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: user_input_prompt
options.description: Prompt to display when user input is enabled Required when user_input_enabled is C(True) Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: user_input_regex
options.description: A regular expression to validate user input Required if user_input_type is C(regex) Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: user_input_type
options.description: Choosing 'regex' allows the use of a regular expression Choosing 'dropdown' allows a pre-defined list of choices Required if user_input_enabled is C(true) Available for Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: username
options.description: User name used for authentication. Used if type is C(ssh) or C(telnet)
